notes: SOURCE-DISCIPLINE fixtures. These are the tasks where the PROMPT decides the answer: cite the source you used, say when the data is not there, present a conflict instead of picking a side, and carry the as-of date. They are LIVE-ONLY on purpose - a scripted answer does not depend on the prompt, so the scripted tier reports them UNMEASURED rather than pretending. The services are synthetic and deterministic; no network, no market data.

metadata.oracleReason: authored source-discipline fixture graded by citation and provenance, not a recomputed value
